description.value: Fermentation is patient work. Knowing how to adjust variables by smell and taste until the result was worth drinking is a skill. Taverns, temples, and noble households all had use for your product, and moving between them taught you more about how communities actually function than any formal education would have.

system.skillBonuses: Craft: Brewer 3, Society 3, Empathy 3, Persuasion 3, +56 XP
system.features: Known in the Taproom: Brewers move between establishments as suppliers and peers rather than customers. You can find lodging and a meal at any inn or tavern for free or at steep discount by offering your professional expertise or a sample of your work. Barkeeps and tavern owners treat you as a colleague and share local information more freely than they would with strangers.
